title: A CI fix found in one repo reaches the others: one shared browser-test setup
why: Oct 26: degen's PR 263 went red when its browser setup timed out on Ubuntu's slow package mirror, the same cause claude-settings fixed for itself the same day (c64). The fix never reached the child repos.
note: claude-settings part built: PR 644 (one shared Playwright setup and an apt-install probe), head b9ebcff, dispatch run 40396955015 green, two Sonnet review rounds (round 2 clear). actions/playwright-setup pins Playwright from a lockfile, caches the browsers by version and runs no apt step; gates-shoot uses it (setup 9 s, cold cache). compliance_probes.py playwright flags installs that run apt; today it flags degen (2), banchi (2), q_max (1), joyous (1); mailaudit in shape. Decision one-browser-setup-no-apt. Three review notes in debts/notes.md. Fault (Oct 26): degen's own workflow; the claude-settings gap was that a CI fix could not reach other repos. Child-repo part deferred (shiv, Oct 26): each repo drops its apt step and adopts the action in its own lane, after your plan check; degen also skips web tests on native-only changes. Port: yes, banchi, q_max, degen, joyous (the four the probe flags). Linked: c76 keeps pins to this action current.
